title: 直壁由腿起身
description: 水彩中，成人在低直壁以腿推动完成短距离上移。

art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: Create an original watercolor illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult making a short leg-driven rise on a low vertical bouldering wall. A bent right leg stands onto a broad foothold while the left shoe stays securely on a lower positive step, and large turquoise handholds offer relaxed support. The torso remains close to the wall without hanging from locked bent elbows. Use a medium-wide side-oblique view that includes the whole figure, distinct hold contacts, and continuous thick crash mats. Paint transparent peach walls, blue-gray trousers, and soft afternoon light. Keep the movement controlled, proportions adult and credible, with no text, branding, jumping, or exposed height.
